boundary.evidence: self-contained CLI gate in its owning skill's scripts/ (mirrors check-bdd-coverage)

ownership.evidence: RULES table is the single rule source; traces to zero-downtime-db-migrations.md

dependency.evidence: grep-battery clean — only node:fs/node:path, no web/transport

error-handling.evidence: die→exit 2 on usage/IO (report, not swallow); violations→exit 1; fail-closed on zero-scan

findings.title: add-not-null-no-default false-flagged the skill's own safe 3-step (CHECK … NOT VALID + final SET NOT NULL)
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a team following the skill's guidance hits red CI on 2 of 3 statements — the false-red that trains people to disable the gate
findings.evidence: reviewer: `ADD CONSTRAINT c CHECK (col IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID` → exit 1 [add-not-null-no-default]
findings.resolution: added (?!CONSTRAINT) lookahead + unless NOT VALID so only ADD COLUMN…NOT NULL fires; documented the final SET NOT NULL needs an inline ignore; test added

findings.title: gate omitted taught rules while claiming '1:1' (FK/CHECK without NOT VALID; one-shot UPDATE)
findings.question: ownership
findings.whatBreaks: a maintainer trusts a green gate as 'all skill rules enforced' and ships a lock-taking FK validation
findings.evidence: reviewer: `ADD CONSTRAINT fk FOREIGN KEY …` → exit 0
findings.resolution: added fk-check-not-valid rule (+test); one-shot UPDATE is not text-detectable → softened '1:1' wording in header+ADR and recorded as out-of-scope limitation

findings.title: alter-column-type over-matched a column literally named 'type'
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.resolution: tightened regex to require ALTER COLUMN <name> TYPE adjacency; test added

findings.title: trailing inline ignore mis-scoped across the ';' split (waived the NEXT statement)
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a reason trailed onto statement A actually waived B
findings.evidence: reviewer: `DROP TABLE a; -- ignore …`⏎`DROP TABLE b;` suppressed b
findings.resolution: splitter now extends a statement to end-of-line so a trailing comment binds to its own statement; 2 scoping tests added

findings.title: reason.length<3 waiver guard was untested (mutation survived)
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a refactor could drop the guard and let a 1-char reason count as a waiver
findings.evidence: reviewer removed the guard → 15/15 still passed
findings.resolution: added a test: a 1-char reason does not suppress

findings.title: regex linter mis-handles $$ bodies / string literals / dialect quirks
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a ';' or keyword inside a function body/string can over-flag
findings.evidence: reviewer: CREATE FUNCTION … $$ … DROP TABLE tmp; … $$ → exit 1 (over-flag only, never a missed top-level unsafe stmt)
findings.resolution: accepted as documented v1 limitation (over-flag is the safe direction; ignore escape hatch exists); header limitations section expanded

verdict: 6 findings (2 med, 4 low), all resolved or accepted-as-documented in this change
